targets.expr:
(((count by (instance) (count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"integrations/(node_exporter|unix)", instance=~".*ec2.*",deployment_environment="$env"}) by (cpu, instance))) 
- 
avg by (instance) (sum by (instance, mode)(irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"integrations/(node_exporter|unix)", instance=~".*ec2.*", mode="idle",deployment_environment="$env"}[$__rate_interval])))) * 100) 
/ 
count by(instance) (count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"integrations/(node_exporter|unix)", instance=~".*ec2.*",deployment_environment="$env"}) by (cpu, instance))

panels.title: CPU Usage Efficiency by Instances
Total CPU Utilization in Seconds Across All Instances

targets.expr:
(
  (1 - sum without (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"integrations/(node_exporter|unix)", instance=~".*ec2.*", mode=~"idle|iowait|steal",deployment_environment="$env"}[$__rate_interval])))
/ ignoring(cpu) group_left
  count without (cpu, mode) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"integrations/(node_exporter|unix)", instance=~".*ec2.*", mode="idle",deployment_environment="$env"})
) * 100
